title: Important Updates to Binance Link and Trade Rebate Structures
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,  As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the  Binance Link Program , we are restructuring our rebates model for the Link and Trade program. The program offers trading rebates to eligible partners when users connect directly to Binance through the partner’s trading platform.   Effective 2025-10-01 00:00 (UTC) , new Link and Trade brokers will also be evaluated in the second quarter after they join and will be disqualified from the programme if they fail to meet the Bronze tier requirements. Additionally, the default base rebates of 20% on Binance Spot and 10% on Binance Futures will be discontinued. We encourage our Binance Link clients to review the  Bronze tier requirements  to ensure eligibility and compliance to maintain access to rebates and program benefits.  Please note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!  Binance Team 2025-09-01 Note:  This announcement was updated on 2025-11-28 to clarify the evaluation requirement for new Link and Trade brokers.
